none: PAS KENT-004DC3: Kent-004DC3. Roman coin. Radiate of Tetricus II junior. Reverse view.
contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

A complete, Roman, struck or hammered, copper alloy, radiate or billon Antoninianus, coin of Tetricus II Junior (270-273AD) or possible barbarous copy? Obverse: radiate bust right (young and clean shaven). Inscription: [CPIVESV TET]R(IC)[VS CAE](S). Reverse: Spes (Hope) holding up hem of dress, holding flower and walking left. Inscripton: Illegible. Reece Period 13. Die axis: 12 o'clock. Very fine condition with little wear but rather irregular flan with broken down edges with some pale green verdigris corrosion. This is likely to date between 270-273AD. Ref. Coins of England and the UK, Spink 2014, page 59 No. 565, Identifying Roman Coins, Richard Reece and Simon James, Seaby 1986…
